plot_events: A noblewoman publicly rejects a presented gift, stating it is not the blue rose she desires.
A flamboyant suitor offers a grotesque rose made from an enemy emperor's intestines and frames it as a token of devotion.
The suitor is suddenly interrupted by a violent upward burst of debris or force and is knocked away.
Observers on an upper level react as the disturbance throws the presenter off balance.
Another figure identifies the failed suitor as General Amagho and notes his ownership of the Tazzum mines and great wealth.
The desired woman repeats that the offering is not the blue rose she seeks.
A silver-haired man forcefully advances through the crowd, ordering others aside, apparently bringing a blue rose.

visual_summary: In a grand interior gallery or ceremonial hall, a richly dressed noblewoman rejects a suitor's offering, saying it is not the blue rose she wants. A flamboyantly dressed man presents an extravagant grisly gift and boasts of defeating an emperor, but he is abruptly attacked from below or off-panel: debris erupts upward, he is struck and falls, and onlookers react from a balcony. The scene then shifts to another speaker identifying the disrupted suitor as General Amagho, owner of the Tazzum mines and possessor of a vast fortune. The woman repeats her rejection. In the final panel, a forceful silver-haired man pushes forward, telling others to step aside while holding or reaching toward a blue rose-like object.
